A: Identical SHA256 and bytesize with same basename
B: Identical SHA256 and bytesize across differing names
C: Different bytes under same scoped relative path; kept as versions, semantic similarity unverified
limitations: No deletion candidates are approved. Physical different-inode duplicate logical bytes is not filesystem savings: references, hardlinks, shared extents, metadata and recovery are separate. Identical bytes do not erase provenance. UNIQUE_* values are conservative extension/path protection heuristics, not proof of raw origin or global uniqueness. All UNKNOWN retained.
